highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from reusing evicted glyph locations.

bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite no longer mark an entire glyph vector current after only a partial update, preventing stale atlas fast-path locations.
